title: The complete spherical carrier has even charges and exact circle kernel of order two

spectral_kernel.integer_spectrum: The 2 pi-periodic unitary circle representation decomposes H_ps into integer charge spaces H_q.
spectral_kernel.parity: U(pi)=I implies exp(i pi q)=1 on every nonzero H_q, hence q is even throughout the complete carrier.
spectral_kernel.nontrivial_witness: K1357 places charge q=2 in an M-spherical K-type that occurs in H_ps.
spectral_kernel.exactness: Any circle-kernel angle alpha must satisfy exp(2 i alpha)=1 on the q=2 witness, so alpha is 0 or pi modulo 2 pi; K1711 shows both occur.

claim_ceiling: Every original-circle Fourier charge on H_ps is even and the complete action kernel is exactly the central half-period subgroup. This classifies the repository control representation only; it does not assign observed particle charges.
